page.selectPrompt: Upload audio or start recording to see who said what.
page.uploadConsentBody: Before "{{name}}" is transcribed, attest that the recorded participants were informed and consent to the recording.
page.uploadHelp: MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, WebM, Ogg, Opus, FLAC or AAC · up to {{size}} MiB and {{minutes}} minutes
page.fileTooLarge: Choose a file smaller than {{size}} MiB.
page.serviceUnavailableBody: Processing is not ready. You can still review existing recordings. Contact the person running this app if it does not recover.

recordingBar.micTrackEnded: The microphone stopped providing audio — check your input device.
recordingBar.tabTrackEnded: The shared tab stopped providing audio.
recordingBar.noTabAudio: The shared tab or window provides no audio — only your microphone is being recorded.
recordingBar.mediaInvalid: This recording isn't a valid audio file and can't be uploaded. Please record the meeting again.
recordingBar.mediaEmpty: This recording is empty — no audio was captured. Check your microphone and record the meeting again.
recordingBar.mediaTooSmall: This recording is too short to contain any audio. Please record the meeting again.
recordingBar.incomplete: Some parts of this recording are missing, so it can't be uploaded. Please record the meeting again.
recordingBar.rejectedKept: Your local copy has been kept on this device so nothing is lost — discard it once you no longer need it.
recordingBar.cancelUnconfirmed: This upload couldn't be cancelled because the server is still finishing it. Your local copy has been kept — check the meetings list before discarding it.
recordingBar.cancelConfirmBody: Cancelling permanently discards the audio captured so far. This cannot be undone.
recordingBar.storageUnavailable: Your browser's local storage for recordings can't be reached right now, so nothing has been changed or deleted. Close any other tabs of this app and try again.
recordingBar.storageDegraded: This recording is no longer being saved to this device — if the tab closes now, the audio since the warning appeared may be lost. Stop and upload as soon as you can.
recordingBar.storageOutdated: This app was updated in another tab, so this page is out of date. Reload it to continue — your recording is safe and nothing has been deleted.

empty.title: No recordings yet
empty.body: Use Record audio or Upload audio to create your first transcript. Speakers are separated automatically.

delete.title: Delete recording?
delete.consequence: Its transcript is deleted too, and the audio is removed permanently.

recordModal.title: Record audio
recordModal.name: Recording title
recordModal.includeTab: Also capture another tab / window audio (Chrome, Edge)
recordModal.consent: I confirm participants have been informed this meeting is being recorded
recordModal.needsSecureContext: Recording needs a secure context. Open the app over HTTPS, or via http://localhost / http://127.0.0.1 — browsers block microphone and tab capture on plain-HTTP hostnames.
recordModal.consentRequired: This deployment requires attesting participant consent before recording can start.
recordModal.serviceUnavailable: Transcription is currently unavailable, so a new recording can't be processed. Please try again shortly.
recordModal.storageLockedByOtherTab: Another tab or window of this app is still open with an older version. Close every other tab of this app and try again — your recordings are safe, so don't clear site data.

detail.processing: Processing your recording — this can take a few minutes.
detail.errorGeneric: Transcription failed. You can try again, or record the meeting again.

errorCodes.recording_invalid_container: This recording isn't a valid audio file, so it can't be transcribed. Please record the meeting again — retrying this recording won't help.
errorCodes.recording_incomplete: This recording is incomplete or was cut off, so it can't be transcribed. Please record it again.
errorCodes.recording_unsupported_codec: This recording uses an audio format that isn't supported. Please record it again using a supported browser.
errorCodes.recording_limit_exceeded: This recording is longer or larger than the supported limit, so it can't be transcribed. Please record a shorter meeting — retrying this recording won't help.
errorCodes.recording_decode_timeout: This recording took too long to process and was stopped. You can try again.
errorCodes.transcription_service_unavailable: The transcription service was temporarily unavailable. You can try again once it recovers.
errorCodes.transcription_internal_error: Transcription failed due to an unexpected error. You can try again.

detail.audioUnavailable: The audio for this recording has been removed (retention).
detail.audioError: Could not load the audio for playback
detail.serviceDegradedBody: No transcription worker is running right now. Existing transcripts remain available; new recordings will be refused until the service recovers.
detail.editConflict: This segment changed since you opened it — the transcript has been refreshed; re-apply your edit.
detail.revisionConflicts_one: {{count}} edited segment could not be carried over automatically — review before approving.
detail.revisionConflicts_other: {{count}} edited segments could not be carried over automatically — review before approving.
detail.revisionCarried_one: {{count}} human edit was carried over from the previous revision.
detail.revisionCarried_other: {{count}} human edits were carried over from the previous revision.

revisionErrors.forbidden: You don't have permission to review transcript revisions.
revisionErrors.conflict: This revision can't be changed right now — reopen the review and try again.
revisionErrors.unavailable: Couldn't reach the server — check your connection and try again.
revisionErrors.generic: That didn't work — you can try again.

detail.timelineAria: Speaker timeline — click a block to play from there
detail.approvalNoteHelp: Optional. Say what you checked before you approve.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.subtitle: Saved people and optional voice samples for recognizing speakers in recordings.
speakers.name: Name

empty.title: No speakers yet
empty.body: Add people to assign names in transcripts. With consent, a voice sample can help recognize them automatically.

addModal.title: Add speaker
addModal.consent: This person has consented to voice enrollment (biometric processing)
addModal.help: A name is enough to label transcripts. Voice recognition is optional and needs the person’s consent.
addModal.evidenceHelp: Describe when and how this person agreed to voice recognition.
addModal.evidenceRequired: Describe how consent was obtained, or add the name without voice recognition.

speakers.myVoiceSubtitle: Enroll your voice so recordings can identify you automatically.
speakers.myVoiceNone: You have not enrolled your voice yet.
speakers.consentMine: I consent to my voice being used to identify me in meeting transcripts
speakers.shutdownNotice: Voice features are disabled on this deployment. This page is read-only for compliance — you can still review, erase voiceprints, and run DSAR exports.
speakers.profileDeactivated: Your voice profile has been deactivated. Enrollment is unavailable until an administrator reactivates it; you can still withdraw consent and erase your voiceprints.
speakers.myVoicePending: An enrollment is being processed. You can erase it while it is pending.

comments.title: Comments on {{title}}
comments.emptyBody: Start a discussion about this meeting — comments anchor to the moment being played.
comments.actionFailed: The comment could not be updated.

clips.createFailed: The clip could not be created
clips.invalidRange: The end must be after the start.
clips.emptyBody: Cut a governed excerpt of this recording: set the start and end from the playhead. Clips stay behind the same access controls as the meeting.
clips.playFailed: The clip could not be played.
clips.deleteFailed: The clip could not be deleted.
clips.deleteConsequence: Its audio is removed. The recording itself does not change.

dlp.hint: Find personal details and secrets in this transcript and remove them. Accept what should go, then apply: the words are masked in a new version of the transcript and that part of the audio is muted.
dlp.applied: Redaction queued — the transcript and audio will update shortly.
dlp.emptyBody: Every new transcript is scanned for the things listed above. Add your own words, such as a project name or a personal number, or choose Redact in the menu on a transcript line.
dlp.scanFailed: The scan could not be started.
dlp.updateFailed: The finding could not be updated.
dlp.applyFailed: The redaction could not be applied.
dlp.confirmBody_one: {{count}} accepted finding is masked in a new transcript revision, and its audio range is muted. This cannot be undone.
dlp.confirmBody_other: {{count}} accepted findings are masked in a new transcript revision, and their audio ranges are muted. This cannot be undone.
dlp.emptyBodyScanned: The scan found none of the things listed above. Add your own words, or choose Redact in the menu on a transcript line.

terms.title: What the scan looks for
terms.hint: The first four are always on. Words you add apply to every recording in this workspace.
terms.wordLabel: Word or phrase to look for
terms.wordPlaceholder: A word or phrase, e.g. Project Falcon
terms.addFailed: The word could not be added.
terms.removeFailed: The word could not be removed.

dsar.title: Compliance exports (DSAR)
dsar.subtitle: Export everything the meetings domain holds about a person: consent records, voiceprint metadata (never the biometric itself), appearances, deletion evidence, and their audit trail.
